+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboLab spatula retrieval trajectory. Uses only eai-standard RGB-D and robot proprioception."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from requests.exceptions import RequestException
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = OUT / "runs"
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+VERT = [0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0]  # reset's downward approach
+SIDE = [0.70710678, 0.0, 0.70710678, 0.0]   # fingertips face +x; jaws span y
+
+
+def connect():
+    r = Robot()
+    print("STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+    return r
+
+
+def pose(r, label, xyz, quat, grip=0.0):
+    target = [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat), float(grip)]
+    print("MOVE", label, target, flush=True)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", [target], cameras=None, video="both", video_fps=10,
+                   note=label)
+    folder = RUNS / label
+    res.save(str(folder))
+    print("RESULT", label, json.dumps({
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"), "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "plan": res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+        "executed_rows": res.meta.get("executed_rows"),
+        "tcp": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15],
+        "gripper_opening": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[24:25],
+        "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+    }), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+
+def phase1(r):
+    # Raise above the shelf, move over its open side, then turn to a horizontal side grasp.
+    waypoints = [
+        ("p1_lift", [0.36, 0.00, 0.62], VERT, 0.0),
+        ("p1_over_shelf", [0.36, 0.34, 0.62], VERT, 0.0),
+        ("p1_turn_side", [0.36, 0.34, 0.62], SIDE, 0.0),
+        ("p1_side_entry", [0.16, 0.34, 0.52], SIDE, 0.0),
+    ]
+    for label, xyz, quat, grip in waypoints:
+        res = pose(r, label, xyz, quat, grip)
+        if res.done:
+            return
+
+
+def main():
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "phase1"
+    try:
+        r = connect()
+        if phase == "phase1":
+            phase1(r)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown phase {phase!r}")
+        print("FINAL_STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print("EPISODE_OVER", str(exc), flush=True)
+    except RequestException as exc:
+        print("CONNECTION_ERROR", repr(exc), flush=True)
+        try:
+            r = Robot(timeout=15)
+            print("RESUMED_STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+        except Exception:
+            print("WAIT_STATUS", json.dumps(r.wait_ready()), flush=True)
